text:
maria.prodeng: Heads-up folks — were finalizing a billing policy update this week that affects the free credits program and invoice export format. Please review and share with your squads.

billing-bot: [Automated] Draft saved: https://redwood.internal/drafts/billing-2026 (preview)

dave.billing: Summary for the channel: 1) Free onboarding credits for new self-serve orgs will be discontinued starting 2026-04-20. 2) Invoice CSVs will adopt a clearer line-item breakdown (token, embed, storage) and include a region column. Existing active credits remain valid until their original expiry.

maria.prodeng: To be explicit: this is a program change to simplify billing behavior and reduce common customer confusion, not a price increase.

cfo.sara: We modeled impact — estimated ~6% of trial signups were solely credit-driven. Were preparing a retention offer (3 months at 50% off) we can extend to qualifying orgs.

engops.tyler: Operationally, were also adjusting soft rate-limit behavior. New default for hosted accounts: warning at 80% quota, soft throttle at 120% (this prevents surprise bill spikes). Dedicated/reserved customers are unchanged.

dave.billing: Team action items:
- Product: update signup UI/copy to reflect "no automatic free credits after Apr 20".
- Support: update canned responses and cancellation/refund flow guidance.
- Sales/CS: voucher code generation and playbook for retention offers.
- Eng: change invoice CSV schema to include columns: invoice_id, line_type, usage_units, unit_price, amount, region_code and add schema_version header.

maria.prodeng: Legal has asked for an FAQ entry on how credits interact with partner-granted credits and data retention.

billing-bot: Proposed CSV header change preview:
```
-old: invoice_line,description,amount,total
-new: schema_version=2
-invoice_id,line_type,usage_units,unit_price,amount,region_code
```

engops.tyler: Rollout plan: internal comms today, external blog + support article tomorrow, targeted emails to potentially impacted orgs on 2026-04-03. Migration window for invoice export tools: 2026-04-10 02:00-03:00 UTC (exports may fail during that hour).

dave.billing: Communication guidance: avoid phrases like "canceling trials". Use "updating our onboarding credit program to align with product and billing improvements."

cfo.sara: Finance will map new line_types to GL codes. Expect a short reconciliation spike the first month after launch.

maria.prodeng: Quick tech question for eng: can we add region_code without breaking earlier CSV parsers?

engops.tyler: No technical blocker. Well include schema_version in the file header and bump SDK/export semver. Recommend publishing a migration snippet for python/js.

dave.billing: Draft support reply for CS:
"Your existing credits will remain usable until they expire. New orgs after Apr 20 wont receive automatic free credits; were offering an onboarding discount for qualifying teams. If you need help estimating cost, share your workload and well run a projection."

support.jen: For partner-provisioned trials — will partners still be able to issue credits?

dave.billing: Yes — partner tooling remains; this change affects platform defaults only. Well notify partner teams with a separate partner-facing FAQ.

maria.prodeng: Timeline check: final copy needs legal and finance sign-off by EOD Wednesday so we can send external emails Friday morning. Objections?

cfo.sara: Approved pending a final sanity-check of the cost model and the email template.

engops.tyler: We'll update the SDK changelog and include a parsing example. Also, ops will run a dry-run export to catch downstream consumers.

dave.billing: Ill produce a short migration guide + sample parsing code and drop it in #devex before launch.

maria.prodeng: Great. Ill post the final announcement here when its ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:

billing-bot: [Automated] Owners assigned: @dave.billing (billing), @maria.prodeng (comms), @engops.tyler (ops)

maria.prodeng: Closing loop — final announcement scheduled for 2026-04-03 15:00 UTC unless any blocking concerns are raised here by EOD.
